Finding: The 'Family' category leads in total apps (1,877 apps), representing 19.43% of the Play Store store catalog.
The 'Game' category generated the highest total installs (13,447,924,415 installs).
Free apps represent 92.18% of apps (8,904 apps), while Paid apps represent 7.81% (754 apps).
Free apps achieve substantially higher average installs (8,452,961) compared to Paid apps (76,079).
Reviews and Installs exhibit a strong positive correlation (r = 0.6251), indicating a positive association between review volume and install volume.
User reviews are overwhelmingly Positive (64.04%), followed by Negative (21.29%) and Neutral (14.67%).
Overall average app rating across the Google Play Store is 4.19 / 5.0, with ratings displaying a distinct left-skewed distribution.
Total estimated gross revenue proxy across all paid apps is $291,140,168.79.
